messages.text:
Ivo proposes a guaranteed block of 50 design days for **$42,500** ($850 per day), provided Hearth signs the agreement and pays a 30% deposit within three business days of signing. The deposit reserves the agreed dates and counts toward the fee. A further 40% is due on delivery of the developed design package and 30% on delivery of the final fabrication drawings, each payable within 10 business days.

The design scope covers the exhibit concept, accessible layouts and visitor interactions, and drawings for the fabricator. The fee includes two revision rounds, one after concept review and one after developed design review. Hearth would provide one consolidated set of comments per round. Additional revisions require written approval at $900 per day.

Hearth may fabricate, tour, and promote the exhibit. Ivo retains permission to show photographs of the exhibit in their portfolio and presentations after the public opening, subject to image rights and agreed credit. Fabrication supervision can be booked separately at $900 per day, with dates agreed in advance and travel expenses approved before booking.

Can Hearth commit to the full block and deposit timing? Please share the fabrication slot deadline, the date the fabricator needs final drawings, and any required accessibility deliverables so we can confirm the schedule before signing. If a smaller commitment works better, Ivo can price the agreed days at the standard $900 rate.

Hearth can commit to the full 50-day block and can sign and pay a **20% deposit within three business days of signing**, but it cannot agree to a 30% deposit or place the required installation days outside the design fee. Two structures would work:

**Preferred structure:** **$42,500** for the 50 design days **and two on-site installation days**. Hearth would separately reimburse reasonable, pre-approved site travel up to **$1,500**, against receipts. The installation days would be scheduled in advance and would not consume design days.

**Alternative:** Hearth guarantees **46 design days at $900 ($41,400)**, plus two installation days at $900 ($1,800), for a **fixed all-inclusive total of $43,200**, including Ivo’s site travel and expenses. The deliverables and two revision rounds would remain unchanged.

Under either structure, payment of the design/installation fee would be:

- 20% on signing, reserving the dates;
- 30% after the concept package and first revision round;
- 30% after the developed design package and second revision round; and
- 20% on delivery of the complete final fabrication package.

Milestone invoices would be payable within 10 business days. Hearth would provide one consolidated comment set within three business days of each review package; Hearth’s review periods would not consume design days. Additional revisions would be at $900 per day only under a written change order stating the days and price. Corrections needed to meet the agreed scope or accessibility requirements would not be chargeable revisions.

The final package must expressly include:

- Fabrication-ready drawings and specifications;
- **Editable native/source fabrication files**, including linked assets and any necessary production information, alongside PDFs;
- Accessible layouts and visitor interactions; and
- A **dimensioned, fabrication-ready accessible alternate layout**, with associated interaction and graphic specifications, delivered to the same standard as the primary layout.

For scheduling, Hearth proposes concept delivery by design day 12, developed design by design day 30, and the complete final fabrication package by **design day 46**. The current fabrication hold requires that delivery by design day 46; Hearth cannot guarantee a later slot. Under the 50-day structure, days 47–50 would cover fabricator queries and installation preparation, not postpone final drawings. Please confirm Ivo’s earliest start date so the agreement can convert these deadlines to calendar dates before signature. The two installation dates should also be fixed once fabrication is scheduled, with at least 15 business days’ notice.

Ivo may retain copyright, but Hearth needs a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free license—sublicensable to fabricators and touring venues—to reproduce, modify, fabricate, repair, replace, tour, and promote the exhibit without additional fees. Any third-party materials or license limitations must be identified before final approval.

Finally, the portfolio provision must reflect the sponsor’s embargo: **no public use of exhibit photographs, design images, or presentations before the public opening of the first touring venue, currently scheduled two months after launch**. Earlier use requires Hearth’s written approval and sponsor clearance. After that opening, Ivo may use Hearth-approved images in portfolios and presentations, subject to image rights and the agreed design credit.

Please confirm which fee structure Ivo accepts and the available start date so Hearth can proceed within the three-business-day signing window.

Ivo accepts Hearth’s **$43,200 fixed, all-inclusive alternative** for 46 design days and two on-site installation days, including site travel and expenses. Ivo proposes **Monday, November 30, 2026**, as the earliest start, subject to signature and receipt of the **$8,640 deposit** before work begins. If the deposit arrives later within the agreed three-business-day window, Ivo can begin the next business day.

Ivo accepts the concept, developed design, and final fabrication deadlines on design days 12, 30, and 46. The final handoff includes fabrication-ready drawings and specifications for both the primary layout and the dimensioned accessible alternate, with interaction and graphic specifications for each, editable native files, linked assets, production information, and PDFs. Please send the site address, accessibility requirements, and calendar date and time of the fabricator’s cutoff. That will let us put calendar dates in the agreement before signature, accounting for holidays and Hearth’s two review periods.

Hearth will provide one consolidated comment set within three business days of each review package. The two included revision rounds trigger payments of **$12,960 each** upon delivery of the revised concept and revised developed design packages. The final **$8,640** is due on delivery of the complete fabrication package. These three invoices are payable within 10 business days. Ivo will correct departures from the agreed scope or accessibility requirements without charge. Additional revisions require a written change order stating the days and price at $900 per day.

Once fabrication is scheduled, Ivo and Hearth will fix the two installation dates by mutual agreement with at least 15 business days’ notice. Any further fabrication supervision requires a separate agreement on dates and fees.

Ivo retains copyright and accepts Hearth’s proposed perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free exhibit license, including modification and sublicensing to fabricators and touring venues. Ivo will identify any third-party materials and license limits before final approval. Ivo also accepts the embargo through the public opening of the first touring venue. Earlier public use requires Hearth’s written approval and sponsor clearance. After that opening, Ivo may use Hearth-approved images in portfolios and presentations, subject to image rights and the agreed design credit.

Hearth accepts the **$43,200 fixed, all-inclusive price**, the **$8,640 / $12,960 / $12,960 / $8,640** payment schedule, and the other terms in Ivo’s latest proposal, subject to incorporation of the following project details.

**Contracting and start:** Hearth will sign by **Tuesday, November 24, 2026**, and ensure receipt of the cleared deposit by **Wednesday, November 25**, preserving the **Monday, November 30** start. Work need not begin before receipt of the deposit.

**Site:** Hearth Museum’s main gallery and loading entrance, **18 Hearth Lane, Riverton, NY 12180**. Loading access, security procedures, and the on-site contact will accompany the installation-date notice.

**Accessibility brief:** The primary and alternate layouts must provide an equivalent accessible visitor experience and address:

- The **2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design** and applicable local requirements;
- Accessible routes, circulation and turning space, clear floor space at exhibits, seating where provided, reach ranges, operable parts, viewing heights, and protruding-object hazards;
- Legible type, contrast, glare control, tactile/Braille elements where specified, and accessible interaction heights and controls;
- Captions and transcripts for audiovisual content, and **WCAG 2.1 AA** for any digital interactive interfaces; and
- A dimensioned accessibility drawing set and brief compliance matrix identifying how these requirements are addressed.

These requirements apply to both layouts and to the associated interaction and graphic specifications already included in the fee.

**Calendar schedule:** A design day is Monday–Friday, excluding **December 25, 2026; January 1, 2027; and January 18, 2027**. Hearth’s review periods do not consume design days. Based on a November 30 start:

| Deliverable | Date |
|---|---|
| Concept package, design day 12 | **Tuesday, December 15, 2026, by 5:00 p.m.** |
| Hearth’s consolidated concept comments | **Friday, December 18, by 5:00 p.m.** |
| Developed design package, design day 30 | **Friday, January 15, 2027, by 5:00 p.m.** |
| Hearth’s consolidated developed-design comments | **Thursday, January 21, by 5:00 p.m.** |
| Complete final fabrication package, design day 46 | **Friday, February 12, 2027, by 10:00 a.m.** |

All times are museum local time. The **fabricator’s cutoff is 12:00 noon on Friday, February 12, 2027**, so the final package should be transmitted simultaneously to Hearth and the fabricator by 10:00 a.m. that day.

If Hearth delivers comments late, affected design deadlines extend one design day for each business day of Hearth’s delay. Ivo should notify Hearth promptly if any delay threatens the fabrication cutoff; no other schedule extension or additional fee applies without written agreement.

The agreed design credit will be **“Exhibition design: Ivo.”** Please confirm the holiday and calendar schedule above and incorporate these details into the execution draft.

Ivo confirms the holiday calendar and all five dated milestones. November 24 has passed, so the execution draft uses the actual signature date. The November 30 start and February 12 handoff assume signature and receipt of the cleared deposit by November 25. Please confirm whether both have occurred so the fabrication slot can be secured.

**Hearth Museum and Ivo — engagement agreement for execution**

**Engagement and fee.** Hearth Museum engages Ivo to design an accessible traveling exhibition for a fixed, all-inclusive fee of **$43,200**. The fee covers 46 guaranteed design days at $900 per day and two on-site installation days at $900 per day, including Ivo’s site travel and expenses. The installation days are separate from the 46 design days.

**Design and fabrication handoff.** Ivo will deliver a concept package, a developed design package, and a complete final fabrication package. The final package will include fabrication-ready drawings and specifications for the primary layout and a dimensioned accessible alternate layout to the same fabrication standard. Both layouts will include visitor interaction and graphic specifications. Ivo will supply editable native fabrication files, linked assets, necessary production information, and PDFs.

**Accessibility.** Both layouts will provide an equivalent accessible visitor experience. Ivo will supply dimensioned accessibility drawings and a brief compliance matrix showing how each layout and its interaction and graphic specifications address the following requirements.

- The 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design and applicable local requirements.
- Accessible routes, circulation and turning space, clear floor space at exhibits, seating where provided, reach ranges, operable parts, viewing heights, and protruding-object hazards.
- Legible type, contrast, glare control, tactile and Braille elements where specified, and accessible interaction heights and controls.
- Captions and transcripts for audiovisual content, and WCAG 2.1 AA for any digital interactive interfaces.

**Schedule.** Work begins Monday, November 30, 2026, provided the parties have signed and Ivo has received the cleared deposit by November 25. Design days are Monday through Friday, excluding December 25, 2026, January 1, 2027, and January 18, 2027. Hearth’s review periods do not consume design days. All times below are museum local time.

| Milestone | Deadline |
|---|---|
| Ivo delivers concept package, design day 12 | Tuesday, December 15, 2026, by 5:00 p.m. |
| Hearth delivers consolidated concept comments | Friday, December 18, 2026, by 5:00 p.m. |
| Ivo delivers developed design package, design day 30 | Friday, January 15, 2027, by 5:00 p.m. |
| Hearth delivers consolidated developed-design comments | Thursday, January 21, 2027, by 5:00 p.m. |
| Ivo transmits the complete final fabrication package simultaneously to Hearth and the fabricator, design day 46 | Friday, February 12, 2027, by 10:00 a.m., ahead of the noon fabrication cutoff |

If Hearth delivers comments late, each affected design deadline extends by one design day for each business day of delay. Ivo will promptly notify Hearth if a delay threatens the fabrication cutoff. Any other schedule extension or additional fee requires written agreement.

**Reviews and payments.** The fee includes two revision rounds. Hearth will provide one consolidated set of comments within three business days of receiving each review package. Ivo will correct departures from the agreed scope or accessibility requirements without charge. Additional revisions require a written change order specifying the number of days and the price at $900 per day.

| Payment trigger | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Signing deposit, payable within three business days of signing, with cleared funds due by November 25 for the stated start | $8,640 |
| Delivery of revised concept package following the first revision round | $12,960 |
| Delivery of revised developed design package following the second revision round | $12,960 |
| Delivery of complete final fabrication package | $8,640 |

The deposit reserves the dates and counts toward the fee. Each subsequent invoice is payable within 10 business days.

**Installation.** The site is Hearth Museum’s main gallery and loading entrance, 18 Hearth Lane, Riverton, NY 12180. Once fabrication is scheduled, Hearth and Ivo will agree on the two installation dates with at least 15 business days’ notice. Hearth will provide loading access details, security procedures, and the on-site contact with that notice. Further fabrication supervision requires a separate written agreement on dates and fees.

**Rights, publicity, and credit.** Ivo retains copyright and grants Hearth a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free license to reproduce, modify, fabricate, repair, replace, tour, and promote the exhibit. Hearth may sublicense those rights to fabricators and touring venues without additional fees. Ivo will identify third-party materials and any license limitations before final approval.

The sponsor embargo applies to public use by Ivo of exhibit photographs, design images, and presentations until the public opening of the first touring venue. Earlier public use requires Hearth’s written approval and sponsor clearance. After that opening, Ivo may use Hearth-approved images in portfolios and presentations, subject to image rights. The agreed credit is **“Exhibition design: Ivo.”**

Hearth confirms that it signed on **November 24, 2026**, and that Ivo received the cleared **$8,640 deposit on November 25, 2026**. The **November 30 start**, all five dated milestones, and the **February 12, 2027, 10:00 a.m. final handoff** are therefore confirmed.

Hearth approves the execution draft **without further changes**. It accurately records the fixed fee, deliverables, accessibility obligations, review and payment terms, installation arrangements, license, publicity embargo, and credit. Hearth will notify the fabricator that the noon February 12 cutoff is contractually confirmed so the fabrication slot can be secured.
